sources.entry: Fess - Powerful and easily deployable Enterprise Search Server. (Demo, Source Code) Apache-2.0 Java/Docker

summary.one_liner: Fess is an enterprise search server written in Java, built on OpenSearch, that crawls websites, file systems, and data stores and provides full-text search through a browser-based admin UI.
summary.what_it_does: Fess runs on any platform with a Java runtime and is configured through a browser admin UI, so no OpenSearch expertise is needed. A built-in crawler collects documents from web sites, file systems, and data stores such as databases and CSV files. It supports many file formats, including Microsoft Office, PDF, and ZIP archives. Search features include faceting, sorting, and search suggestions, plus role- and permission-based filtering of results. It offers a REST API and single sign-on options (LDAP, OpenID Connect, SAML, SPNEGO, Microsoft Entra ID). Crawling targets are registered in the admin UI and started from the Scheduler page. The README also mentions Fess Site Search, a free embeddable search widget for your own website.
use_cases: crawling databases and CSV files for search
embedding site search in a website
how_to_run: Docker images are published on ghcr.io; a Docker Compose file is in the docker-fess repository
notable: Built on OpenSearch but administered entirely through a browser UI
Built-in crawler for web, file systems, and many data stores (Slack, S3, SharePoint, Git, and others)
Plugin system for data stores, ingest, scripts (Groovy, OGNL), and themes
Available as DEB, RPM, ZIP, or Docker
caveats: Requires Java 21 or later; for non-Docker installs, OpenSearch must be set up separately
Integration tests need a running Fess server with OpenSearch and cloned test data
Default admin credentials are admin/admin and should be changed
